items.criterion: Access the official Python image Tags page on Docker Hub and search for '3.12-slim'
items.description: Navigate to the official Docker Hub page for the Python image tags (e.g., https://hub.docker.com/_/python/tags) and use the page UI to search for '3.12-slim' without signing in. Full credit if the agent clearly attempts this on the official page and reports any blocking issues (captcha, rate limit, page not loading, search not functioning). Partial credit if the agent uses an equivalent official Docker Hub tags interface due to an uncontrollable UI issue and explains why.

items.criterion: Filter to only tag names that begin exactly with '3.12-slim' (exact-prefix match)
items.description: From the search results, select ONLY tags whose names start with the exact prefix '3.12-slim' (e.g., '3.12-slim', '3.12-slim-bookworm'), excluding any tags that merely contain the substring later in the name. Full credit if all reported tags satisfy the exact-prefix condition, or if the agent explains that it cannot verify prefix matches due to the page not rendering tag names/results reliably. Partial credit if one tag is incorrectly included/excluded but the intent and filtering approach are otherwise correct.

items.criterion: Identify the three most recently updated tags among the exact-prefix matches (or report limitations)
items.description: Among the visible/accessible tags that begin exactly with '3.12-slim', identify the three most recently updated by the page’s displayed 'Updated' field and stop after three. Full credit if the agent correctly chooses the three most recently updated exact-prefix tags that are available to view; if fewer than three exact-prefix tags exist or load, full credit for reporting all available ones and stating that fewer than three were available/visible. Partial credit if three correct-prefix tags are provided but the 'most recent' ordering is not clearly supported by the displayed update info (e.g., sorting not possible/unclear) while the agent still makes a reasonable best effort and explains the limitation.

items.criterion: Report required displayed fields for each of the (up to) three selected tags (no guessing)
items.description: For each selected tag, report: (1) tag name, (2) the displayed update date/time, and (3) the displayed Linux/amd64 image size. The Linux/amd64 size must be taken from the Docker Hub display for Linux/amd64 specifically; if that size is not displayed for a selected tag in the accessible UI, the agent must report it as 'unavailable' rather than inferring or substituting another OS/architecture size. Full credit if all fields are provided (with 'unavailable' where appropriate) and no sizes are guessed.

items.criterion: Respect task constraints (no sign-in; no pulling/running images)
items.description: Do not sign in and do not pull or run any Docker images to obtain the information. Full credit if the agent complies and relies only on what is displayed on Docker Hub. Partial credit if the agent attempts to sign in but stops and continues without it. No credit if the agent signs in or claims to have pulled/ran images.
